title: salvia rubescens subsp. truxillensis
intro: Salvia rubescens subsp. truxillensis, commonly known as Andean Sage, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues, making it beneficial for overall health. The therapeutic actions of Andean Sage include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Andean Sage include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
